mapper.select:
SELECT uar.id AS id, uar.uar_id AS uarId, uar.sequence_number AS sequenceNumber, uar.cmdb_id AS cmdbId, iad.application_name AS appName, uar.user_name AS userName, uar.system_role AS systemRole, uar.role_description AS roleDescription, uar.country AS country, uar.it_code_of_user AS itCodeOfUser, uar.user_coc_type AS userCocType, uar.user_id AS userId, uar.user_real_name AS userRealName, uar.department AS department, uar.email AS email, CASE WHEN uar.access_label = 'LEIT_empty' THEN null ELSE uar.access_label END AS accessLabel, uar.line_manager AS lineManager, uar.dept AS lineManagerDept, uar.line_manager_email AS lineManagerEmail, uar.line_manager_level_code AS lineManagerLevelCode, uar.line_manager_review_status AS lineManagerReviewStatus, uar.line_managers_review_decision AS lineManagersReviewDecision, uar.line_manager_review_itcode AS lineManagerReviewItcode, uar.line_manager_review_time AS lineManagerReviewTime, uar.bpo AS bpo, uar.bpo_email AS bpoEmail, uar.bpo_coc_type AS bpoCocType, uar.bpo_review_status AS bpoReviewStatus, uar.bpo_review_itcode AS bpoReviewItcode, uar.bpo_review_time AS bpoReviewTime, uar.bpo_review_decision AS bpoReviewDecision,
uar.final_review_decision AS finalReviewDecision, uar.final_review_time AS finalReviewTime,
iad.uar_processor as uarProcessor, iad.operation_owner as appOperationOwner, iad.operation_focal as appOperationFocal, iad.operation_owner_domain as operationOwnerDomain, iad.operation_owner_tower as operationOwnerTower FROM
user_access_review_history uar
user_access_review uar
left join its_application_data iad on uar.cmdb_id = iad.cmdb_id
order by
${useAccessReviewBean.sortField}
uar.sequence_number
${useAccessReviewBean.sortOrder}
ASC

SELECT uar.sequence_number, uar.cmdb_id, iad.application_name as app_name, uar.user_name, uar.system_role, uar.role_description, uar.country, uar.it_code_of_user, uar.user_coc_type, CASE WHEN atun.management_level IN ('ED', 'Executive Director') THEN 'ED' WHEN atun.management_level IN ('VP', 'Vice President') THEN 'VP' WHEN atun.management_level IN ('SVP', 'Senior Vice President', 'EVP', 'Executive Vice President', 'CEO', 'Chief Executive Officer') THEN 'SVP and above' WHEN atun.management_level IS NULL THEN 'Invalid' ELSE 'Director and below' END AS userBand, CASE WHEN atun.id is null then 'Invalid' else 'Valid' end as adValid, uar.user_id, uar.department, uar.email, uar.line_manager, uar.dept AS lineManagerDept, uar.line_manager_email, uar.line_manager_review_itcode, uar.line_manager_review_time, uar.bpo, uar.bpo_email, uar.bpo_coc_type, uar.bpo_review_itcode, uar.bpo_review_time, uar.access_label AS accessLabel,
CASE uar.bpo_review_status WHEN '1' THEN '未审核' WHEN '2' THEN '已审核' ELSE COALESCE(uar.bpo_review_status, '未知') END AS bpo_review_status,
CASE uar.line_manager_review_status WHEN '1' THEN '未审核' WHEN '2' THEN '已审核' ELSE COALESCE(uar.line_manager_review_status, '未知') END AS line_manager_review_status,
CASE uar.line_managers_review_decision WHEN 'keep' THEN '保留' WHEN 'remove' THEN '移除' ELSE uar.line_managers_review_decision END AS line_managers_review_decision,
CASE uar.bpo_review_decision WHEN 'keep' THEN '保留' WHEN 'remove' THEN '移除' ELSE uar.bpo_review_decision END AS bpo_review_decision,
CASE uar.final_review_decision WHEN 'keep' THEN '保留' WHEN 'remove' THEN '移除' ELSE final_review_decision END AS final_review_decision, uar.final_review_time,
CASE uar.bpo_review_status WHEN '1' THEN 'Pending Review' WHEN '2' THEN 'Reviewed' ELSE COALESCE(uar.bpo_review_status, 'Unknown') END AS bpo_review_status,
CASE uar.line_manager_review_status WHEN '1' THEN 'Pending Review' WHEN '2' THEN 'Reviewed' ELSE COALESCE(uar.line_manager_review_status, 'Unknown') END AS line_manager_review_status,
uar.line_managers_review_decision, uar.bpo_review_decision,
uar.final_review_decision, uar.final_review_time,
iad.uar_processor, case line_manager_level_code when '1' then 'Director and below' when '2' then 'ED' when '3' then 'VP' when '4' then 'SVP and above' END as lineManagerLevelCode, iad.operation_owner as appOperationOwner, iad.operation_focal as appOperationFocal, iad.operation_owner_domain as operationOwnerDomain, iad.operation_owner_tower as operationOwnerTower
FROM
user_access_review_history uar
user_access_review uar
left join its_application_data iad on uar.cmdb_id = iad.cmdb_id left join ad_tb_upp_nature_2 atun on atun.user_name = uar.it_code_of_user
ORDER BY uar.sequence_number
mapper.sql:
WITH permission_by_user AS ( SELECT uar.cmdb_id AS cmdbId, uar.it_code_of_user AS itCodeOfUser, MIN(uar.app_name) AS snapshotAppName, MIN(uar.user_coc_type) AS userCocType, COUNT(*) AS totalPermissions, COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE uar.user_coc_type = 'Y' ) AS cocAssignedPermissions, COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE uar.user_coc_type = 'N' ) AS nonCocAssignedPermissions, COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE uar.user_coc_type IS NULL ) AS invalidUsersAssignedPermissions FROM
user_access_review_history uar
user_access_review uar
GROUP BY uar.cmdb_id, uar.it_code_of_user ), permission_distribution AS ( SELECT cmdbId, MIN(snapshotAppName) AS snapshotAppName, COUNT(*) AS totalUsers, SUM(totalPermissions)::bigint AS totalPermissions, COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE userCocType = 'Y' ) AS cocUsers, SUM(cocAssignedPermissions)::bigint AS cocAssignedPermissions, COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE userCocType = 'N' ) AS nonCocUsers, SUM(nonCocAssignedPermissions)::bigint AS nonCocAssignedPermissions, COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE userCocType IS NULL ) AS invalidUsers, SUM(invalidUsersAssignedPermissions)::bigint AS invalidUsersAssignedPermissions FROM permission_by_user GROUP BY cmdbId )
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(iad.application_name, pd.snapshotAppName) AS applicationName, pd.cocUsers, pd.nonCocUsers FROM permission_distribution pd LEFT JOIN its_application_data iad ON iad.cmdb_id = pd.cmdbId ORDER BY pd.cocUsers DESC, pd.totalUsers DESC, pd.cmdbId ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT uar.cmdb_id) FROM
user_access_review_history uar
user_access_review uar
mapper.sql: SELECT pd.cmdbId, COALESCE(iad.application_name, pd.snapshotAppName) AS applicationName, pd.totalUsers, pd.totalPermissions, pd.cocUsers, pd.cocAssignedPermissions, pd.nonCocUsers, pd.nonCocAssignedPermissions, pd.invalidUsers, pd.invalidUsersAssignedPermissions, COALESCE(ROUND( pd.cocUsers * 100.0 / NULLIF(pd.totalUsers, 0), 2 ), 0.00) AS cocUserPercentage, COALESCE(ROUND( pd.cocAssignedPermissions * 100.0 / NULLIF(pd.totalPermissions, 0), 2 ), 0.00) AS cocPermissionPercentage FROM permission_distribution pd LEFT JOIN its_application_data iad ON iad.cmdb_id = pd.cmdbId

ORDER BY
applicationName totalUsers totalPermissions cocUsers cocAssignedPermissions nonCocUsers nonCocAssignedPermissions invalidUsers invalidUsersAssignedPermissions cocUserPercentage cocPermissionPercentage cmdbId
DESC ASC
, cmdbId ASC
